overview.description: The NYLIM CBRE Real Assets ETF (REIX) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI World index. The fund is an actively managed equity strategy that invests globally in companies tied to real assets, such as infrastructure and real estate. The fund seeks total return through growth and income REIX was launched on May 10, 2023 and is issued by NYLIM.
